_comment: Physical element catalog. Each entry is the authoritative specification for how a natural phenomenon must be rendered. Bricks and motifs derive from these — never the reverse. Palette colors may tint but never override physical color constraints.

physical.object: Earth's natural satellite at 100% illumination phase
physical.angular_size: ~0.5 degrees in Earth sky — appears as a defined disk, not a point
physical.surface: Regolith-covered sphere with impact craters, maria (dark basalt plains), and highland regions (brighter anorthosite)
physical.at_full_moon: Nearly shadowless from Earth's perspective — craters show as albedo rings, not relief shadows

required: varied crater sizes (1px to 8px radius at scale)

lighting.model: diffuse full illumination — no terminator line visible
lighting.limb_darkening: soft radial darkening 10-15% toward edge of disk
lighting.crater_shadow: minimal at full phase — primarily albedo contrast, not shadow
lighting.glow: subtle atmospheric scatter halo around disk in 0.02-0.05 radius range

color.halo: warm or cool depending on atmospheric conditions — opacity 0.08-0.15

layers: 1. outer atmospheric glow — large radialGradient, very low opacity (0.06-0.1)
2. limb darkening — radialGradient from edge inward, subtle darkening
3. base sphere — radialGradient slightly off-center highlight
4. maria — 3-5 feTurbulence-masked ellipses at 30-45% opacity
5. crater field — feTurbulence noise overlay with feColorMatrix threshold
6. surface texture — fine feTurbulence noise, very low opacity (0.04-0.08)
filter_techniques: feGaussianBlur for glow and limb softening

physical.object: Moon at 15-30% illumination, showing lit crescent and dark limb
physical.earthshine: Faint illumination of dark portion by light reflected from Earth — visible as ghostly full disk outline

layers: 1. full disk at very low opacity for earthshine
2. crescent mask — clip circle offset to reveal only crescent portion
3. crescent fill with surface texture (same as full-moon surface spec)
4. thin bright limb edge on lit side

physical.object: Solar corona visible only during totality — extends 2-3 solar radii
physical.structure: Plasma streamers radiating from hidden sun disk, not uniform ring
physical.color: Pearlescent white with warm inner edge, cool outer streamers

layers: 1. outer corona — very large low-opacity radialGradient
2. streamer base — anisotropic feTurbulence rays from center
3. inner corona — tighter bright radialGradient
4. moon disk — near-black filled circle on top, slightly smaller than sun

physical.object: Moon fully inside Earth's umbra — illuminated only by light refracted through Earth's atmosphere
physical.color_source: Red wavelengths from all of Earth's sunrises and sunsets projected onto moon surface

layers: 1. penumbral glow — large warm radialGradient behind disk
2. disk base — deep crimson radialGradient
3. color variation — subtle feTurbulence-masked warm/cool zones within disk
4. limb brightening — slightly brighter edge on one side (uneven eclipse depth)

physical.object: Plasma emission from solar wind particles colliding with atmospheric gases at 100-300km altitude
physical.structure: Curtain-like vertical bands, not horizontal. Bottom edge sharper, top fades. Bands move and pulse.
physical.colors: Green (oxygen at 100km), red (oxygen at 200km+), blue/purple (nitrogen) — often multiple simultaneously

required: undulating waving motion implied by shape

color.palette_use: Use palette hueGreen/hueCyan as primary, but ensure vertical orientation

layers: 1. background glow — wide soft gradient wash at horizon
2. main curtain bands — vertically-oriented feTurbulence with high Y/X ratio
3. undulation — feDisplacementMap to create wave in curtain
4. brightness nodes — localized bright spots along bands
5. upper fade — linearGradient mask fading to transparent at top
svg_spec.turbulence: baseFrequency: low X (0.002-0.005), high Y (0.02-0.06) for vertical structure

physical.object: Random distribution of stars with power-law brightness distribution
physical.structure: Many faint stars (80%), some mid-brightness (15%), few bright anchor stars (5%)
physical.milky-way: Optional: diffuse band of unresolved stars at low opacity

physical.object: Dark open ocean surface reflecting sky light
physical.structure: Horizontal with slight wave texture — reflections of aurora, stars, or moon distorted by waves
physical.depth_cue: Darker at horizon, slightly lighter where reflecting sky at viewer angle

required: bright specular highlights from light sources

color.base: Very dark, near-black with slight blue-green tint
color.reflection: Same hue as sky light source at 40-60% opacity
color.specular: Point highlights from moon/stars at high opacity

layers: 1. base dark water fill
2. horizontal feTurbulence for wave texture (low Y, moderate X frequency)
3. reflection strip — linearGradient of sky color masked by wave turbulence
4. specular highlights — scattered bright points along wave peaks

physical.object: Deep ocean water column 200m-4000m — no surface light, bioluminescence only light source
physical.structure: Pressure currents flow horizontally at varying depths — visible as streaming turbulence patterns
physical.bioluminescence: Scattered light organs of organisms — point sources at very low density

physical.object: Water droplet suspension at ground level — radiates from cold surface upward
physical.structure: Tendrils rise from ground, not uniform horizontal band. Denser at base, thinner at top. Objects partially obscured.
physical.light_interaction: Scatters and diffuses any light source — creates soft halos around lights, obscures distant objects

required: partial object occlusion (silhouettes visible through fog)

color.base: Near-white to light gray when illuminated
color.night_fog: #1a2028 tinted very slightly by light source

layers: 1. base fog density — linearGradient dense at bottom, sparse at top
2. tendril structure — feTurbulence with moderate Y variation over low X
3. light scattering halo — radialGradient around any light source within fog
4. depth fade — objects at distance have higher fog opacity

physical.object: Rocky peaks silhouetted against night sky
physical.structure: Jagged irregular skyline — no two peaks same height or spacing. Ridge lines have texture.
physical.depth: Multiple layers at different distances — closer = darker, farther = slightly lighter (atmospheric perspective)

required: subtle surface texture on lit ridges
occasional ridge highlight from moon or aurora

color.ridge_highlight: Moonlit: cool silver. Aurora-lit: tinted with aurora color

physical.object: Wind-formed sand ridges — sinusoidal cross-section with sharp crests and gentle windward slopes
physical.structure: Dunes have a specific anatomy: windward slope (gentle, 10-15°), slip face (steep, 30-34°), sharp crest line
physical.at_night: Lit by moon — cool silver on windward face, dark slip face. Stars reflected in inter-dune flat sand.

required: asymmetric dune profile (windward vs slip face)
sharp crest line with slight glow

layers: 1. base dark fill for inter-dune areas
2. dune body — cubic bezier path, asymmetric sides
3. windward highlight — linearGradient on lit slope
4. crest highlight — thin bright stroke along top edge
5. ripple texture — fine anisotropic feTurbulence

physical.object: Large-scale limestone/sandstone stepped pyramid — Egyptian style (Giza proportions)
physical.proportion: Base:height ratio approximately 1.57:1 (Great Pyramid). Faces slope at ~52 degrees.
physical.at_night: Lit from one side by moon or fire — half in deep shadow, half showing surface stone texture. Stars visible behind.

required: correct proportions (not too steep or flat)
stone block texture on lit face

layers: 1. shadow face — dark trapezoid polygon
2. lit face — trapezoid with linearGradient (lighter top, darker bottom)
3. stone texture — horizontal feTurbulence bands at low opacity
4. edge detail — slightly irregular polygon path (not perfect straight lines)
5. ground cast shadow — feGaussianBlur dark ellipse

physical.object: Stratovolcano or shield volcano cone with summit vent activity
physical.structure: Cone profile with rounded summit, lava channels on flanks, ash cloud above vent

forbidden: palette-derived hue — ALWAYS hardcode lava colors

physical.object: Combustion of organic material — turbulent convection column of burning gases
physical.flame_anatomy: Base: hot blue-white core (rare, near fuel). Lower: orange-yellow primary combustion zone. Tips: red-orange dimmer ends. Outer envelope: near-transparent hot gas.
physical.motion_implied: Flame tongues extend upward and lean with air currents — not symmetric

layers: 1. ground glow — large radialGradient at base
2. back flames — 2-3 bezier tongues, slightly cooler color, behind
3. front flames — 3-4 bezier tongues, hotter color, front
4. hot core — bright ellipse at base of flame column
5. ember particles — scattered small circles above

physical.object: Electrical discharge — stepped leader + return stroke
physical.structure: Primary channel: near-vertical with characteristic Z-direction changes. Branch forks: exponentially smaller. Width: 1-5cm real, should appear as thin bright line.
physical.color: Core is white to blue-white plasma (>30,000K). Outer glow is purple-blue from ionized nitrogen.

required: fractal branching (recursive smaller branches from main channel)
bright white core + purple-blue outer glow

ocean-night-surface.label: Open ocean at night from above

physical.object: Vast open ocean surface under night sky
physical.horizon: Very dark, nearly black water. Slight phosphorescence in wave crests in some conditions.
physical.reflection: Moon path: bright ribbon of reflected moonlight across water surface. Star reflections: scattered points at wave peaks.

physical.object: Towering convective clouds — anvil top, dark base
physical.structure: Cauliflower-textured upper portions, flat base, interior lightning illumination from within

color.lit_from_within: brief brighter flash, same tone as cloud but +30% lightness

physical.object: Fjord or lake reflecting aurora above
physical.structure: Reflection is vertically mirrored but distorted by ripples. Colors same but slightly desaturated. Brighter lines = wave crest specular.

scenarios._comment: Each scenario assembles elements into a complete scene. Motifs reference these. Physical constraints override palette constraints.

arctic-aurora-fjord.label: Arctic fjord under aurora borealis
arctic-aurora-fjord.composition: Sky occupies 60-70% of canvas. Aurora in upper-mid. Mountains as silhouette in lower third. Fjord water at bottom 20%.
arctic-aurora-fjord.palette_role: hueCyan/hueGreen tint aurora. bgDark for water and terrain. Stars use white hardcoded.

full-moon-desert.label: Full moon over desert with pyramids
full-moon-desert.composition: Moon in upper right. Stars scattered upper half. Pyramids mid-canvas. Dunes foreground. Optional light fog at pyramid base.
full-moon-desert.palette_role: Moon colors hardcoded. Dune warmth can tint from hueOrange at 30% max.

solar-eclipse-totality.label: Total solar eclipse at totality
solar-eclipse-totality.composition: Eclipse centered upper-mid. Stars visible (daytime stars during totality). Mountain silhouette at bottom.
solar-eclipse-totality.palette_role: Corona is hardcoded white. Moon disk is near-black. Stars are white.

blood-moon-rise.label: Total lunar eclipse blood moon
blood-moon-rise.composition: Moon prominent, mid-upper. Atmospheric haze around it. Dark mountains below.
blood-moon-rise.palette_role: Blood moon ALWAYS hardcoded crimson. Never palette-derived.

deep-ocean-bioluminescence.label: Abyssal ocean — bioluminescent jellyfish
deep-ocean-bioluminescence.composition: Water column fills canvas. Jellyfish in mid-upper water. Ocean floor terrain at bottom 20%.
deep-ocean-bioluminescence.palette_role: Water darkness from bg/bgDark. Bioluminescence from hueCyan. Hardcode if palette corrupts.

mountain-lightning-storm.label: Lightning over mountain ridge
mountain-lightning-storm.composition: Clouds fill upper 40%. Lightning strikes mid-canvas. Mountains below. Fog at base.
mountain-lightning-storm.palette_role: Lightning hardcoded white/blue-white. Clouds use bgMid/bgSoft. Fog near-transparent.

volcanic-night.label: Active volcano at night
volcanic-night.composition: Volcano cone center-lower. Lava glow illuminates surroundings. Ash cloud above.
volcanic-night.palette_role: Lava ALWAYS hardcoded. Ash cloud uses bgMid darkened.

ocean-midnight.label: Open ocean under full moon at midnight
ocean-midnight.composition: Moon upper right. Stars across upper half. Ocean takes lower 35%. Optional fog on horizon.
ocean-midnight.palette_role: Moon hardcoded. Ocean uses bg darkened. Moon reflection path hardcoded warm white.

fog-mountain-valley.label: Mountain valley filled with fog
fog-mountain-valley.composition: Mountains frame upper sides. Fog fills valley (mid-lower). Moon above. Stars sparse.
fog-mountain-valley.palette_role: Fog uses bgSoft at very low opacity. Mountains use bg darkened.

campfire-wilderness.label: Campfire in wilderness at night
campfire-wilderness.composition: Campfire lower center. Warm glow illuminates immediate ground. Stars bright above (no moon).
campfire-wilderness.palette_role: Fire ALWAYS hardcoded. Stars white. Mountains near-black.
